name: LookupEvents

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
用于请求下一页检索的结果。  

请求参数必须保证和上次请求一致
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of results to return.
Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
允许返回的最大结果数目。  
取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify both `StartTime` and `EndTime`, or leave both unspecified. If you leave them unspecified, the default value of `StartTime` is 7 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
检索事件的开始时间，日期格式按照ISO8601标准，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。
StartTime和EndTime需同时设置或均不设置，不设置时StartTime默认为当前时间7天前的时间点
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

You must specify both `StartTime` and `EndTime`, or leave both unspecified. If you leave them unspecified, the default value of `EndTime` is the current time
parameters.help_zh:
检索事件的结束时间，日期格式按照ISO8601标准，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`。
StartTime和EndTime需同时设置或均不设置，不设置时EndTime默认为当前时间点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The order in which events are retrieved. Valid values:

FORWARD: Chronological order.

BACKWARD (default): Reverse chronological order
parameters.help_zh:
检索事件的读取顺序，取值：

FORWARD：正序。
BACKWARD（默认值）：反序
parameters.name: direction

fields.name: value

EndTime.description_zh: 检索到事件的结束时间

items.description_en:

NextToken.description_en:
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists
NextToken.description_zh:
返回下一页的检索结果。

若无更多结果，则不返回此字段
